figures.title: Hoechst image: nuclei, host cells and Toxoplasma
figures.text: One Hoechst image of HeLa cells infected with Toxoplasma gondii. Host cells and parasite vacuoles are predicted from the Hoechst channel alone by two spaCR cross-channel models. Nuclei come from stock Cellpose-SAM on the same channel.
figures.alt: Hoechst fluorescence image of HeLa cells with bright nuclei and faint cytoplasm

model.note: Pixels below 500 set to 0, diameter 90 px

facts: HeLa field, plate 1 well L08 field 12, test split (held out by well)

figures.title: Cell-mask image: Toxoplasma, nuclei and host cells
figures.text: The same field imaged with a whole-cell stain. Parasite vacuoles and nuclei are predicted from this channel alone by two spaCR cross-channel models, so no nuclear or parasite stain is needed. Host cells come from stock Cellpose-SAM on the same channel.
figures.alt: Whole-cell stain fluorescence image of the same HeLa field
facts: HeLa field, plate 1 well L08 field 12, test split (held out by well)

figures.title: Toxoplasma vacuoles: parasitophorous vacuole segmentation
figures.text: One fluorescence image of the Toxoplasma channel from an infected host-cell monolayer. Parasitophorous vacuoles are segmented by spaCR's PV model. This well is in the dataset's held-out test split and was not used to train the model.
figures.alt: Greyscale fluorescence image with bright, rounded Toxoplasma vacuoles scattered over faint host cells

model.note: Test F1 0.854 on 11 held-out wells (model card). 136 vacuoles in the hand-curated mask; F1 0.874 at IoU 0.5 on this well

facts: Anchor well plate7_K07_8, test split (held out from training)

figures.title: Plaque assay: Toxoplasma plaques
figures.text: A crystal-violet plaque-assay well from a published figure. Plaques are segmented by spaCR's plaque model. This well was not used to train the model.
figures.alt: Greyscale image of a crystal-violet stained well with pale plaques in a dark monolayer

model.note: The default plaque model in spaCR since 2026-10-11. Model card: F1 0.815 on 263 held-out fields (v3 0.844). 98 plaques in the hand-drawn mask; F1 0.960 at IoU 0.5 on this well

facts: Cabral G, et al. Microbiol Spectrum 2024, Fig. 2
